ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: loud and merry
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They laugh a lot, and loudly, and expect the rest of the table to join in. They take newcomers in sooner and keep game nights; a dour member is out of step, and a serious-minded group easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: serious-minded
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They have little time for jokes, and less for people who tell them at the wrong moment. A joker among them is out of step, and they clash with a loud and merry group.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: keep to themselves
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They don't go out of their way for anyone outside their own, and they don't expect anyone to go out of theirs. Newcomers wait longer to be taken in. A warm-hearted member is out of step, and a group that looks after its own is quick to fall out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: look after their own
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They look out for one another, and a newcomer is made welcome before anyone asks a name. Newcomers are taken in sooner; a cold, distant member is out of step, and they clash with a group that keeps to itself.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: suspicious of outsiders
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Trust is earned among them, slowly, and newcomers wait a long while to be taken in. A trusting soul among them is out of step, and a group open to anyone easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: open to anyone
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Anyone who sits down with them is one of them by the end of the evening, so newcomers are taken in much sooner. A suspicious member is out of step, and they clash with a group suspicious of outsiders.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: brave to a fault
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They are first into any fight, and think less of whoever hangs back. A timid member is out of step, and a group that keeps its head down easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: keep their heads down
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They don't take chances, and look sideways at those who do. A reckless member is out of step, and they clash with a group that's brave to a fault.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: quick to take offense
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: A careless word to one of them is a careless word to all of them. Newcomers wait longer to be taken in, and a group slow to anger easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: slow to anger
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Shouting gets you nowhere with them. They wait until you've finished, then carry on. A hothead among them is out of step, and they clash with a group quick to take offense.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: think well of themselves
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They are sure they do things best, and say so, often. It takes newcomers longer to win them over.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: always look on the bright side
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Whatever happens, they find a reason it could have been worse, and drink to that. A gloomy member is out of step, and a group that expects the worst easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: expect the worst
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They have seen how things go, and they are seldom wrong about it. A cheerful member is out of step, and they clash with a group that always looks on the bright side.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: set in their ways
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Things are done the way they've always been done, and newcomers must learn that before they're taken in, which takes longer here. Someone restless for new ideas is out of step, and a curious group easily falls out with them.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: always after something new
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: They want to hear every new idea and meet every new face, so newcomers are taken in sooner. A stick-in-the-mud among them is out of step, and they clash with a group set in its ways.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: hard workers
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: The day's work comes first with them, and anyone who slacks hears about it. It holds while at least half of them are industrious by nature.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: keep late hours
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Their evenings run long into the night, and their mornings start late. It holds while at least half of them are night owls, and they keep the small hours together.

ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.label: devout
ColonyCouncil.GroupNormDef.description: Their ideoligion is the center of their days, and they keep its rites together. Only a group of the faithful has this way.
